name: Liam Baker
bio:
Liam's journey into motorsport catering began unexpectedly during a gap year spent traveling across Europe. While working at a small Italian trattoria near the Imola circuit, he was drawn to the energy and camaraderie surrounding the racing teams. He started helping out at the team's makeshift paddock kitchen, quickly learning the ropes of feeding a hungry crew under pressure.

Back in New Zealand, Liam honed his skills working in high-end restaurants while volunteering at local racing events. His approach to catering is simple: provide nutritious, delicious food that fuels both body and mind. He emphasizes fresh, locally sourced ingredients and a menu that caters to diverse dietary needs. What sets Liam apart is his ability to adapt to the ever-changing demands of the track, anticipating needs and delivering consistent quality, even under tight deadlines.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly cropped with a slight wave
physical.description: Liam is of average height with a stocky build and a friendly, open face.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down menu ideas and track-specific ingredient availability.
Insists on playing upbeat Kiwi music during meal prep to boost team morale.
Has a habit of taste-testing every dish multiple times to ensure perfection.
